- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The linked issue (PR #6972 / issue #6972) asks the implementer to "Update the step-script contract and inventory, then rerun the size and contract tests" and "confirm the workflow is under the guard and the gate tests pass."
  Expected change site: `tests/test_pr_base_freshness_gate.py:706-733` (`FreshnessSyncWiring::test_the_gate_routes_a_verified_update_to_deterministic_skip_merge`).
  Evidence of absence: The file is not in PR CHANGED FILES. It still imports `WORKFLOW = REPO_ROOT / ".github" / "workflows" / "review_autofix.yml"` and `text = WORKFLOW.read_text(encoding="utf-8")` (lines 28, 707) and asserts on inline gate markers that are now in `scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh` — `MERGE_BASE_SYNC_FAST_PATH_ENABLED` (line 709), `gate_freshness_sync_fast_path()` (line 710), the `bash .codex-head-gate-src/scripts/review_head_gate.sh freshness-sync` heredoc (line 711), the `or ($b | contains("<!-- ai:merge-base-sync:v1 "))` filter (line 708), and the `HEAD_GATE_HELPER_VERIFIED` early-return guard (line 712). The fix is the same pattern the PR already applied elsewhere: route reads through `expanded_review_autofix_text()` and import the helper. The test sits in `.github/workflows/ci.yml:1220` under the failing `tests-promote-stall-and-review` job (CI run 38214532748).
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The "Evaluate review gate" shim-migration contract test must keep passing after the gate body moves. The PR updates 5 other test files in the same migration (issue #6634) to use `expanded_review_autofix_text()`, but not this one.
  Expected change site: `tests/test_workflow_gh_retry_fallback_contract.py:455-474` (`test_gh_api_retry_migrated_steps_carry_the_shim` and `test_gate_pr_read_fails_loudly_instead_of_skipping`).
  Evidence of absence: The file is not in PR CHANGED FILES. It still calls `_gh_api_retry_workflow("review_autofix.yml")` (line 426, which is `(REPO_ROOT / ".github" / "workflows" / name).read_text(encoding="utf-8")`) and then `_gh_api_retry_step(text, "Evaluate review gate")` (line 471). With the inline body gone, the assertion `'_pr_gate="$(gh_api_retry "repos/${REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}"' in step` (line 473) and `"::error::AUTOFIX_GATE_PR_READ_FAILED pr=${PR_NUMBER} rc=${_pr_gate_rc}" in step` (line 474) cannot pass — those lines now live in the sourced script. The other shim-migration tests in the same loop (e.g. validate.yml, implement.yml) still carry the shim inline and keep passing, so this test is uniquely broken by the move. The test sits in `.github/workflows/ci.yml:1246` under the failing `tests-promote-stall-and-review` job.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
